meta.title: Qualy LinkedIn Visuals
meta.summary: Two Turkish-first LinkedIn visuals for Qualy AI, built as a clean continuation of the first launch post while staying inside documented product behavior.

items.title: DM'ler kaybolmasın.
items.caption: Shows WhatsApp, Instagram, and Telegram feeding into Qualy's unified inbox. Messenger is intentionally omitted because current app code marks it as coming soon.
items.tone: Clean dark SaaS, respond.io-inspired hierarchy, Turkish SMB launch
items.prompt: Deterministic Creative Production export for Qualy AI LinkedIn: headline DM'ler kaybolmasın.; active channels WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram; unified inbox, AI reply, AI talep özeti, and missing information collection. No fake metrics, no customer proof, no unsupported campaigns or follow-up automation.

items.title: Takip edilecek talep hazır.
items.caption: Shows Qualy AI summarizing service, purpose, missing info, priority, and operator handoff. No unsupported CRM charts, automation, or revenue claims.
items.tone: Clean dark SaaS, light product UI crop, operator-control emphasis
items.prompt: Deterministic Creative Production export for Qualy AI LinkedIn: headline Takip edilecek talep hazır.; Skills + Bilgi Bankası, AI talep özeti, lead/request priority, missing information, and operator takeover. No fake features, no customer logos, no unsupported integrations.
